description: Implantation des stations d'épurations du Gers is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département du Gers. The Technical Assistance Service for Purification Station Operators (SATESE) Since 1998, with the support of the Adour Garonne Water Agency, SATESE has been offering project owners and operators technical support for the operation of collective sewerage systems, with regular monitoring of wastewater treatment networks and plants. Coverage: Département du Gers. The portal shows the English title as "Installation of the Gers sewage treatment plants" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Département du Gers. Its keywords include developpement-durable, traitement-de-leau, station-depuration. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, JSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2021-02-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
